Asia/Shanghai is UTC+8. US/Mountain is UTC-7 in standard time (assuming 1036 is not during DST, as DST was not widely used then).  
Time difference: UTC-7 minus UTC+8 = -15 hours.  
4 PM = 16:00 on Feb 28.  
16:00 - 15 hours = 01:00 on Feb 29 (1036 is a leap year).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1036-02-29 01:00
